_about: The Nemesis's lines (R42): pools keyed by his faction (his voice), then by moment, plus small pools per personality, lines about his scars, and lines about how you beat him last time. godot/story/rival.gd picks one line per moment from the pools with a hash of his name, the moment and the battle seed, so each run's Nemesis sounds different but stays consistent within a battle. Rewritten to lore round 8 (R59): each faction speaks in the bible's voice (lore_bible_r8.md 1.3). Placeholders: {rival} his full name, {you} your admiral's name, {flagship} your flagship's name, {scars} how many times he has been scarred (as a word: once, twice, three times). Moments: hail (his battle starts, first meeting), again (a later meeting after you beat him), final (his last fight, sector III), beaten (his flagship breaks and he escapes), death (his flagship dies in his last fight), gloat (you lose to him), kill (he destroys one of your ships), signature (his faction's own behaviour, when stream B's rules fire it), scar (a later meeting, he talks about his scars), memory.<how> (a later meeting, he talks about how you beat him: lance, torp, sq, ram, board, battery, evasive; stream B's nem.beat words map onto these, broad to battery, ion to lance, evaded to evasive). Personas are stream B's own (data.js NEM_PERSONA, four per faction in NEM_FAC[fac].personas); the Nemesis carries his as nem.persona. Any other id falls back to the faction pools. No em dashes. deed: the beat 1 calling card by personality ({rival_deed}). final_by: his beat 3 hail, picked in the order remembers (you beat him before or he is scarred), mercy, ruthless (your choices' leaning), else sun (what the Hollow Sun means to him). Pronoun tokens {He} {he} {him} {his} follow his gender (it for a Chorus mind).

personalities.cunning: Strikes your flanks and your weakest ship.
personalities.zealous: Charges in and never backs off.
personalities.patient: Waits for you to come to him.
personalities.proud: Leads from the front with his flagship.
personalities.greedy: Goes for your richest prize, your flagship.
personalities.methodical: Holds his line and advances only in formation.

hail: Who carries the dawn? I do. You are in my way.
Your name is already chalked on my hull, under the line where the dead go.
Turn back, and live cold. Come on, and burn.
again: We meet again. I paid for our last meeting in names. Now you pay.
I lived so I could finish this.
You won once. The oath calls that a debt, not a verdict.
final: Behind me is the thing stealing the light from forty worlds. You will not stand between me and it.
I have come a long way in the cold to put my hands on this fire. Yours are in the way.
Here, at the Hollow Sun, the debt comes due. Yours or mine.
beaten: This is a debt, not a defeat. I will come back to collect it.
Mark this day. I will make you regret every hour of it.
death: Chalk my name... under the line...
gloat: One more name for the wall. Not one of ours.
Burn the wreck. Let it light the way home.
kill: Another name you will have to chalk.
signature: I challenge you, flagship to flagship. The fleet will watch.
Face me alone, if your oath means anything.
scar: You marked me {scars}. I wear each scar like a brand.
Every scar you gave me is a line in my oath of debts.

memory.lance: Your lances burned me last time. I have doubled my screens since.
memory.torp: You hid behind torpedoes last time. A coward's weapon. I am ready for them now.
memory.sq: Your little wings stung me last time. I have brought guns for every one of them.
memory.ram: You rammed me like an animal. I have armoured my prow for you.
memory.board: Your boarders walked my decks. Every corridor has a name chalked in it now. Theirs are waiting.
memory.battery: You battered me with broadsides. I have learned to move away from them.
memory.evasive: You ran from my guns last time. There is nowhere left to run.

zealous.hail: I swore an oath to stop the dark. You look like dark to me.
zealous.beaten: The oath tests me. I will pass.

proud.hail: I am the dawn watch of forty worlds. You will remember my name as you burn.
proud.beaten: You have insulted me. I keep a careful account.

cruel.hail: I have burned out six of your outposts on the way. Yours will make seven.
cruel.beaten: Run, then. I will burn everything you pass.

methodical.hail: Oath-breaker identified. The debt is called.
methodical.beaten: Withdrawing. The debt is delayed, not cancelled.

deed.zealous: {He} chalked every name in the place on the walls, then burned it, so the names would be the last thing standing.
deed.proud: {He} left a formal challenge chalked across the door, signed with {his} full name and every title.
deed.cruel: {He} burned everything but one thing, so you would know it had been chosen.
deed.methodical: {He} left a reckoning, three lines long, with your name on the third.

final_by.sun: Behind me is the thing stealing the light from forty worlds. You will not stand between me and it.
final_by.remembers: You marked me {scars}. I kept every scar for this reckoning.
final_by.mercy: You spared the weak on your way here. The cold will not.
final_by.ruthless: You came here with stolen coin and burning wakes. At least you will match the place.

hail: You have been designated a priority target. Comply by dying.
Attention, unregistered fleet. You are now an entry in the Registry.
This sector is under Hegemony administration. You are not on the list.
again: Our previous engagement has been reviewed. Corrections have been made.
You are in my file now. It is a thick file.
Last time was a statistical outlier. Today is the average.
final: The Registry projects one fleet in this anchorage. It will not be yours. Stand down and be counted.
This is your final notice. Stand down, or be removed from the projection.
The anchorage is closed to you. Permanently.
beaten: Tactical withdrawal. This is noted in your file, not mine.
Disengage. Regroup. This is not over.
death: Note the time. For the report.
Flagship lost. Command passes to... nobody.
gloat: Target neutralised. Log it and move on.
signature: All reserve squadrons, jump in now. Encircle them.
scar: You damaged me {scars}. Each time, the Registry allocated me a better ship.
My scars are logged, catalogued and avenged in order.

memory.lance: Your lances strained my shields last time. My emitters have been upgraded.
memory.torp: Torpedoes, last time. My point defense officers have been retrained. Some of them replaced.
memory.sq: Your wings caught us unscreened last time. That officer is no longer with us.
memory.ram: You rammed my line. Unprofessional. My prows are reinforced now.
memory.board: You boarded my ships. My marines have orders to take no prisoners.
memory.battery: Your batteries outgunned us at close range. We will not close this time.
memory.evasive: You evaded my gunnery last time. My gunners have run the drill four hundred times since.

proud.hail: I hold a Registry rank you will never be issued. You are a rounding error.
proud.beaten: This will not appear in my service record. You will.

patient.hail: I have held this lane for eleven days. You are on schedule.
patient.beaten: Withdrawing. The schedule allows for this.

cunning.hail: Your route was predicted eleven days ago. Welcome.
cunning.beaten: Acceptable losses. You have revealed your doctrine.

deed.methodical: {He} left an inventory of what was taken, and when {he} will return for the rest.
deed.proud: {He} left a notice of claim, numbered and countersigned.
deed.patient: {He} sealed the doors and left a timetable on them: the hour {he} expects you, to the minute.
deed.cunning: {He} left a forwarding address that is a trap, and a polite note saying so.

final_by.sun: The Registry projects one fleet in this anchorage. It will not be yours. Stand down and be counted.
final_by.remembers: Our last engagement has been reviewed. The review recommends your removal.
final_by.mercy: You stopped for stragglers. I read the report. I would not have.
final_by.ruthless: You left people behind for a bonus. I read that report too. We should not both be here.

hail: I heard your engines three jumps out. I have been following your stink ever since.
Big fleet. Lots of plate. I will wear some of it.
Your ships hum. You can hear them a system away. I did.
again: Remember me? I remember your wake. I could follow it blind.
Back for more. Good. I need the plate.
You were stronger last time. Strongest keeps it. Let us see who is strongest now.
final: The biggest fight in known space, and you came to it. Good. Now I find out what you are worth.
I tracked you across three sectors to get here first. Strongest keeps it. Come and see.
All of you, all of us, at the Sun. Whoever is left keeps everything.
beaten: Not today. I know your wake now. I will be behind you.
Scatter. Run dark. Meet at the den.
gloat: Strip it. Bolt the good plate on. Leave the rest.
kill: Hear that? That was your ship.
signature: Take what we can carry and run dark. We are done here.
Enough for one hunt. Run silent. Scatter.
scar: You marked me {scars}. The pack saw every one. I owe you for each.
See this face? You did this. I kept the dents as trophies.

memory.lance: Your lances cut my pack apart last time. I have bolted on twice the plate.
memory.torp: You torpedoed me last time. I brought more rockets.
memory.sq: Your little fighters chewed my hulls. I have chaff on everything now.
memory.ram: You rammed me. That is how we fight. Do it again. I want to see it.
memory.board: Your boarders took my best ship. I want it back. I want you with it.
memory.battery: Your guns peppered me last time. I have thicker plate now. Some of it was yours.
memory.evasive: You ran circles round me last time. I followed your trail anyway. I always do.

cunning.hail: You followed my trail. I laid it for you.
cunning.beaten: Lost a few ships. Got what I came for, though.

greedy.hail: That flagship of yours. I want its plate on my harness.
greedy.beaten: Keep it, then. For now. I know its smell.

proud.hail: Every den from here to the Ashfall knows my howl. Soon you will too.
proud.beaten: Nobody does this to me. Nobody.

cruel.hail: I keep the crews I catch. In the engine gangs. For a while.
cruel.beaten: Run. I will take it out on the next convoy.

deed.cunning: {He} left one trophy plate behind, with your name scratched in it, which is worse than a threat.
deed.greedy: {He} stripped everything, then came back for the bolts.
deed.proud: {He} clawed {his} mark into the door, very deep, where the whole pack could see it.
deed.cruel: {He} left the crew alive, in the airlock, with the outer door ajar.

final_by.sun: The biggest fight in known space, and you came to it. Good. Now I find out what you are worth.
final_by.remembers: Last time you were stronger. I kept your dents as trophies. Come and add one.
final_by.mercy: I heard you went soft on the way in. Soft ships open easy.
final_by.ruthless: I heard you burned your way here. Strong. I will still take it.

hail: We followed your scent across the stars. Now we feed.
Meat that thinks. Meat that runs. Meat that screams when it breaks.
again: We remember the taste of you. We want more.
You hurt us. We grew. We are larger than your hurt now.
The swarm learned your smell. It is waiting.
final: It is warm in our mouths already. You are the part in the way.
Many mouths. One hunger. You are the meal that runs.
The warm thing is ours to eat. And so are you.
beaten: Wounded. Not ended. We remember the taste of you.
signature: Your dead feed us. Thank you for your dead.
Every ship you lose makes us stronger. Lose more.
scar: You cut us {scars}. The scars grew teeth.
Our wounds closed over your name. We feel it in every scar.

memory.lance: Your light burned us. We grew thicker skins in the dark.
memory.torp: Your fire-seeds hurt us. We grew mouths that eat them.
memory.sq: Your little stingers came. We grew spores to catch them.
memory.ram: You crashed into us. We grew shells.
memory.board: Your crawlers came inside us. We digested them. Send more.
memory.battery: Your many small fires hurt. We learned to move between them.
memory.evasive: You were hard to catch. We grew faster mouths.

cruel.hail: We eat slowly. So you can hear it.
cruel.beaten: We will eat your colonies while you chase us.

cunning.hail: We waited where you would come. You came.
cunning.beaten: Lost a limb. Grew a plan.

patient.hail: We waited in the dark until you were fat. Now.
patient.beaten: We wait again. We are good at waiting.

deed.ravenous: {He} ate everything, the walls included, and left the hole.
deed.cruel: {He} ate slowly, so the rest could watch.
deed.cunning: {He} left the doors open and the food out, and waited to see who came.
deed.patient: {He} waited until the young were fat, then ate only those.

final_by.sun: It is warm in our mouths already. You are the part in the way.
final_by.remembers: We remember the taste of you. We want the rest.
final_by.mercy: You leave food on the plate. We do not.
final_by.ruthless: You eat like us. Good. We will eat you like us.

hail: I have watched your fleet for three systems. I am sorry it has come to this.
You are carrying a light you do not understand. Put it down.
Turn back. I will not ask a second time, and I will be sorry.
again: We meet again. I remember every second of our last meeting. I will remember this one longer.
You were lucky once. Light does not stay lucky.
I have had a long time to think about how you beat me. I was careful with the time.
final: We built the light. We will not let it be stolen again. Not by them, and not by you.
My grandmother's grandmother helped build what lies behind me. I came to shut it down. You are in the way.
This is where the light was taken. It will not be taken twice.
beaten: A small setback, in a long life. We will meet again.
I withdraw. Not because you won. Because I can afford to wait.
death: So the light goes out... gently. I am sorry.
Turn the mirrors... toward the Sun...
gloat: I am sorry. Truly. Mourn them, if you know how.
Another light gone out. There are never enough.
kill: One fewer. I am sorry for it.
signature: Your flagship and mine, alone. Let us see whose glass is clearer.
Enough. I have seen what I came to see. We withdraw.
scar: You marked me {scars}. In three centuries no one else has.
My scars catch the light now. I look at them often.

memory.lance: Your crude lances found my shields last time. I have ground them finer.
memory.torp: Your torpedoes surprised me once. Surprise is spent.
memory.sq: Your little wings swarmed me. I have brought starlings of my own.
memory.ram: You threw your ships at mine like stones. I will not stand still for it again.
memory.board: Your boarders walked my halls. We cleared them with light, and I am still sorry.
memory.battery: Your guns were loud and many. I have learned to step between them.
memory.evasive: You slipped out of reach last time. I have been slipping out of reach for longer.

cunning.hail: I chose this place a long time ago, for exactly this.
cunning.beaten: Expected. The light bends. So do I.

proud.hail: My family ground the lenses of the Lattice. Yours had not yet learned to make glass.
proud.beaten: You will not live long enough to boast of this.

patient.hail: I watched your grandparents' grandparents learn to jump. I can wait out you.
patient.beaten: There will be another hour. There always is, for me.

cruel.hail: I will let one of your ships live, so it can tell the others how the rest went dark.
cruel.beaten: Go. Your worlds are fragile. I am sorry for what I will do there.

deed.cunning: {He} left everything exactly as it was, minus one thing nobody noticed for a week.
deed.proud: {He} left a single flawless lens on the floor, ground to a focus nobody living can match.
deed.patient: {He} turned every mirror in the place toward the Hollow Sun, and left them to wait.
deed.cruel: {He} stayed long enough for every light there to burn out, one by one.

final_by.sun: We built the light. We will not let it be stolen again. Not by them, and not by you.
final_by.remembers: You scarred me {scars}. I had not been scarred in three centuries. I have been thinking about you.
final_by.mercy: You let an old thing rest, once. That was kind. It will not save you.
final_by.ruthless: You broke old things to get here. Then we are alike, and I am sorry for you.

hail: You stand between us and noon. We have waited a thousand years for noon.
This is my ninth body. You will not be the one who ends it.
You are warm. I remember warm. Step aside.
again: You delayed me. I have been restored since. You have only grown older.
I was rebuilt from the last copy. It remembers you clearly.
Our last meeting is in the Archive. So is how it ends.
final: Behind me is the frame of a new sun. It needs every key. You will not be the one who keeps one.
We gave up our bodies and our sun for forever. Forever is long. Do not make it longer.
We remember noon. After today, you will not remember anything.
beaten: This frame is lost. I am not.
A delay. The count resumes shortly.
gloat: Archived. Your crews are copied. We consider it a kindness.
Done. It will not come back. Ours do.
kill: One fewer, and it does not come back.
signature: Did you think a broken frame would stop me? I have worn nine.
Restore. Every mind, from the last copy.
scar: You broke my body {scars}. Each time the swarms rebuilt it, and I remembered more.
My scars are copied into every frame I wear. So is your face.

memory.lance: Your beams cut my hull last time. The new plates are thicker.
memory.torp: Your torpedoes cracked me. My spires are awake now.
memory.sq: Your small craft annoyed me. That is corrected.
memory.ram: You struck me with your hull. Crude. Effective once.
memory.board: Your boarders entered my ship. We copied them into the Archive and let them go. They are still there. In a sense.
memory.battery: Your guns chipped at me. I have been chipped for a thousand years.
memory.evasive: You avoided my arcs last time. I have recalculated.

patient.hail: I have waited a thousand years. Your arrival changes nothing in the count.
patient.beaten: A delay. I am patient. I have had to be.

proud.hail: I helped overdrive a star. Address me accordingly.
proud.beaten: This insult is copied into every body I will ever wear.

cruel.hail: I will not kill your crews. I will copy them. Forever.
cruel.beaten: I withdraw to your colonies. Their stars are small. I will start there.

deed.patient: {He} left a counter running on the wall, and it was counting down to you.
deed.proud: {He} left the last recorded image of Ardent burning on every screen, so you would know what {he} had lost.
deed.cruel: {He} copied the crew into {his} Archive and left their bodies standing at their stations.
deed.methodical: {He} catalogued the place, and left the catalogue on the door with your name on the last page.

final_by.sun: Behind me is the frame of a new sun. It needs every key. You will not be the one who keeps one.
final_by.remembers: You delayed me. Delay is all the warm ever manage.
final_by.mercy: Your restraint is noted. We were restrained once. It did not save the sun.
final_by.ruthless: You broke things to reach this place. So did we, a thousand years ago. Look where it led.
